feature_name: Eventarc trigger integration with API hub
summary: API hub is now integrated with Google Cloud Eventarc so users can create Eventarc triggers for API hub events and launch custom workflows.
extended_definition: API hub is now integrated with Google Cloud Eventarc so users can create Eventarc triggers for API hub events and launch custom workflows.

This quickstart shows you how to create and configure an Eventarc trigger that executes a Cloud Run service when an API is updated in API hub.
Create an Eventarc trigger In the Google Cloud console, go to the Eventarc Triggers page.
